VBO:0200851.summary: Veterinarian Stuart Fitzgerald describes the Mal-Shi as cheerful, alert and affectionate, thriving on human company. His account notes an interest in new visitors, ball games and exploring a garden. This is the Maltese–Shih Tzu companion cross.
VBO:0200851.shortDescription: A Maltese–Shih Tzu cross described by veterinarian Stuart Fitzgerald as cheerful, affectionate and keen on company.

sources.title: DogZone — Dr Stuart Fitzgerald on the Mal-Shi
